title: ESP32-S3 strapping pins and EN reset RC
reviewed: 2026-10-28 against the sources below (owner sign-off pending, like the part record)

sources.HWC: Espressif ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, Schematic Checklist (docs.espressif.com .../esp32s3/schematic-checklist.html, 'latest', copyright 2023-2026, read 2026-10-28)

policy.ext_pull_note: POLICY, not an Espressif number: an external pull resistor above this is treated as too weak to define the level against the unspecified internal weak pull (the datasheet gives no internal resistance).

pins.internal_src: DS Table 4-1 (p.13): GPIO0 weak pull-up, bit value 1
pins.normal_src: DS Table 4-3 (p.14): SPI Boot = GPIO0 1; HWC 'Strapping Pins': default is SPI Boot, recommended to place a pull-up resistor at GPIO0
pins.cap_src: HWC 'Strapping Pins': 'Do not add high-value capacitors at GPIO0, or the chip may enter download mode'. Espressif gives no number: 1 nF is the POLICY limit used here

download.src: DS Table 4-3: Joint Download Boot = GPIO0 0 and GPIO46 0; entering it needs GPIO0 pulled low externally

pins.normal_src: DS Table 4-5 (p.15): GPIO3 'Ignored' while the JTAG eFuses are at their default 0. If EFUSE_STRAP_JTAG_SEL is burnt the level must be defined externally

pins.internal_src: DS Table 4-1: GPIO45 weak pull-down, bit value 0
pins.normal_src: DS Table 4-4 (p.15): GPIO45 0 (EFUSE_VDD_SPI_FORCE 0) = VDD_SPI 3.3 V; 1 = 1.8 V flash regulator, which under-supplies a 3.3 V flash

pins.function: boot mode (with GPIO0) and ROM message print
pins.internal_src: DS Table 4-1: GPIO46 weak pull-down, bit value 0
pins.normal_src: DS Table 4-3: SPI Boot = GPIO46 any value

download.src: DS Table 4-3: Joint Download Boot needs GPIO46 = 0; an external pull-up makes GPIO0 = 0 / GPIO46 = 1 an undefined mode

reset.src: DS section 9 'Peripheral Schematics' note (p.41): RC delay at EN, 'usually R = 10 kOhm and C = 1 uF', to be adjusted to the supply power-up timing; HWC 'Chip Power-up and Reset': CHIP_PU must not float. The ranges (R 4.7k-47k, C 0.1-10 uF = a decade around the recommendation) are POLICY, Espressif gives no range
